fields.Challenge: Challenge 6 - Severe winter smog and urban air pollution assistant
fields.Describe the changes/updates made in the: Built Breathe with live Open-Meteo/CAMS modeled outdoor air quality, source timestamps, stale-data handling, household personalization, low-emission daily routines, indoor-air guidance, community pledges and a transparent CO2 scenario calculator. Integrated server-side Google Gemini with secret protection, critical-safety responses, bounded retries and clearly labeled fallback. Added a sourced 30-case golden dataset, 63 passing automated tests, pinned GitHub CI and CodeQL analysis. Current provider HTTP 503 errors are recorded honestly; final live-model validation remains blocked.
fields.Mention the Gen AI services utilized in: Google Gemini API is integrated server-side for contextual clean-air chat using normalized household preferences, bounded conversation context and server-fetched air estimates. Production selects Gemini 4 Hydrogen via stateless Interactions requests; the key is stored as a Vercel Secret. An initial Gemini Flash-Lite smoke test generated a real answer; subsequent requests returned HTTP 503, so final live-model validation has not passed. Curated fallback is explicitly labeled. Open-Meteo/CAMS supplies real modeled air data and is not a GenAI service.
